Różnica (BBC \\ Al Jazeera): Kategoria: Ukraine conflict: What we know about the invasion Russia has begun a large-scale military attack on Ukraine, its southern neighbour, on the orders of Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Kategoria: There are reports of attacks on Ukrainian military infrastructure across the country, and Russian convoys entering from all directions.
Kategoria: Here is what we know so far.
Kategoria: Putin orders attack In a televised speech at 05:55 Moscow time (02:55 GMT), Mr Putin announced a "military operation" in Ukraine's eastern Donbas region.
Kategoria: This area is home to many Russian-speaking Ukrainians.
Kategoria: Parts of it has been occupied and run by Russian-backed rebels since 2014.
Kategoria: Mr Putin said Russia was intervening as an act of self-defence.
Kategoria: Russia did not want to occupy Ukraine, he said, but would demilitarise and "de-Nazify" the country.
Kategoria: He urged Ukrainian soldiers in the combat zone to lay down their weapons and go home, but said clashes were inevitable and "only a question of time".
Kategoria: And he added that any intervention from outside powers to resist the Russian attack would be met with an "instant" and devastating response.
Kategoria: Explosions heard across the country BBC correspondents heard loud bangs in the capital Kyiv, as well as Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region of eastern Ukraine.
Kategoria: Blasts have also been heard in the southern port city of Odesa.
Kategoria: Russia's defence ministry has denied attacking Ukrainian cities - saying it was targeting military infrastructure, air defence and air forces with "high-precision weapons".
Kategoria: Tanks and troops enter Ukraine Tanks and troops have poured into Ukraine at points along its eastern, southern and northern borders, Ukraine says.

Kategoria: Russian military convoys have crossed from Belarus into Ukraine's northern Chernihiv region, and from Russia into the Sumy region, which is also in the north, Ukraine's border guard service (DPSU) said.
Kategoria: Belarus is a long-time ally of Russia.
Kategoria: Analysts describe the small country as Russia's "client state".
Kategoria: Convoys have also entered the eastern Luhansk and Kharkiv regions, and moved into the Kherson region from Crimea - a territory that Russia annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
Kategoria: The Russian offensive was preceded by artillery fire and there were injuries to border guards, the DPSU said.
Kategoria: There have also been reports of troops landing by sea at the Black Sea port cities of Mariupol and Odesa in the south.
Kategoria: A British resident of Odesa told the BBC many people were leaving.
Kategoria: Deaths reported About 10 civilians are believed to have been killed, including six in an air strike in Brovary near the capital Kyiv.
Kategoria: A man was also killed in shelling outside the major eastern city of Kharkiv.
Kategoria: A Ukrainian presidential adviser said that more than 40 soldiers had died and dozens more were wounded.
Kategoria: Ukraine said it had killed 50 Russian troops.

Kategoria: Russian President Vladimir Putin has launched a military operation in Ukraine, with explosions heard across the country and Ukraine’s foreign minister warning a “full-scale invasion” was under way.
Kategoria: What do we know about the invasion so far?

Kategoria: The build-up to war Weeks of intense diplomacy and the imposition of Western sanctions on Russia failed to deter Putin, who had massed between 150,000 and 200,000 troops along the borders of Ukraine.
Kategoria: Russia has demanded an end to NATO’s eastward expansion and said Ukrainian membership of the US-led Atlantic military alliance was unacceptable.

Kategoria: Shelling had intensified since Monday when Putin recognised two separatist regions as independent and ordered the deployment of what he called peacekeepers, a move the West called the start of an invasion.
Kategoria: In response, Western countries and Japan have imposed sanctions on Russian banks and individuals.
Kategoria: On Wednesday, the separatists issued a plea to Moscow for help to stop alleged Ukrainian aggression – claims the United States dismissed as Russian propaganda.
Kategoria: As it appeared Russia was preparing to attack, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made an emotional address to the nation, saying the war would be “a big disaster”.

Kategoria: “If they try to take our country away from us, our freedom, our lives, the lives of our children, we will defend ourselves,” he said On Thursday morning, Putin said he had authorised military action to defend itself against what he said were threats emanating from Ukraine.
Kategoria: An official also reported non-stop cyberattacks.
Kategoria: Zelenskyy said that martial law had been declared.

Kategoria: Ukrainian media reported that military command centres in Kyiv and the city of Kharkiv in the northeast had been struck by missiles while Russian troops had landed in the southern port cities of Odesa and Mariupol.
Kategoria: Russian troops attacked Ukraine from Belarus as well as Russia with Belarusian support, and an attack was also being launched from annexed Crimea, Ukraine’s border guard service said.
Kategoria: Russia’s defence ministry said it had taken out military infrastructure at Ukrainian airbases and degraded its air defences.
Kategoria: Ukraine closed its airspace to civilian flights citing a high risk to safety, while Russia suspended domestic flights at airports near its border with Ukraine until March 2.
Kategoria: Russian-backed separatists in the east said they had captured two towns, the RIA news agency reported.
Kategoria: What has the reaction been?
Kategoria: The invasion triggered swift condemnation.
Kategoria: He said he would speak to G7 leaders and promised Russia would be held “accountable”.

Kategoria: UN chief Antonio Guterres urged Russia “in the name of humanity” to step back from what could be “the worst war since the beginning of the century with consequences not only devastating for Ukraine, not only tragic for the Russian Federation but with an impact we cannot even foresee”.

Kategoria: The European Union’s foreign policy chief Josep Borrell said Russia faces “unprecedented isolation” over its attack on Ukraine and will be hit with the “harshest sanctions” the EU has ever imposed.
